candidate.user_input: What are the eligibility criteria and required evidence for reimbursement of academic courses, and which ancillary fees are excluded?
candidate.reference: For academic courses relevant to your GitLab career development goals, the G&D Fund can be used to cover tuition and enrollment. To be eligible, the course must be from an accredited college or university and result in a final grade equivalent to a "B" or higher. Additional fees related to books, travel, and supplies are not covered under this category. A final grade report or transcript is required for reimbursement.

source_conditions: Academic courses must be relevant to GitLab career development goals.
The G&D Fund can be used to cover tuition and enrollment for eligible courses.
The course must be from an accredited college or university.
The course must result in a final grade equivalent to a "B" or higher.
Additional fees related to books, travel, and supplies are not covered.
